newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was active late Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed fully $1.00 higher than last Friday.

Inquiry and demand were good. Sales confirmed on 22,100 slaughter steers and 26,400 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 61,500 head confirmed including 10,300 head or about 17 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1050-1300 lbs, mostly 1175- 1200 lbs 65.00; few select with end choice 1175-1300 lbs 64.00-64.50, pen 1150 lbs holsteins 60.00.

Heifers - select and choice 2-3 975-1100 lbs 65.00; few early 64.00-64.50; few select with end choice 1000-1050 lbs 64.00-65.00; few mixed commercial to choice 1050-1100 lbs heifers and heiferettes 62.00- 65.00.
week to date: 61500 last week: 101300 last year: 17000
